name: Projection Jacobian Computation
definition: Computes the $2 	imes 3$ Jacobian matrix of the perspective projection function with respect to 3D coordinates, used for linearizing the projection of 3D Gaussians.
summary: Projection Jacobian Computation calculates the 2x3 matrix linearizing 3D Gaussian projection into screen space, transforming covariance for accurate splatting while clamping coordinates to prevent numerical instability.
